title: Anvil Note Block/铁砧味音符盒
description: 铁砧上的音符盒可以发出铁砧声 / The note block on the anvil can produce an anvil sound.
body:
### 主要内容介绍
现在，放置在铁砧下方的音符盒可以发出铁砧声，而且开裂的铁砧具有更高的音域，可以方便编写铁砧音MAD（？）；
同时，在铁砧下方放置有铁块时，可以使发出的声音更长，这样你也可以创作出像我一样的铁砧音MAD了:(

### 附加指令
现在，你还可以使用
```
/bpm <BPM数字> <bool>
```
来将BPM数字转换为游戏刻，后面的布尔值可不填，默认为false，若为true最后计算的值就不再乘以2。

作者主页：https://space.bilibili.com/3546619769260163



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


### Main Features

Now, a note block placed under an anvil will produce an anvil sound. Moreover, a cracked anvil has a higher pitch range, making it easier to create anvil-based MADs (?).

Additionally, if an iron block is placed beneath the anvil, the sound will last longer, allowing you to create anvil MADs just like mine :(

### Additional Command

You can now use:


```
/bpm <BPM number> <bool>
```


to convert a BPM value into game ticks. The boolean parameter is optional and defaults to false. If set to true, the final calculated value will no longer be multiplied by 2.

Author's homepage: https://space.bilibili.com/3546619769260163
